title: Can I SURVIVE Giveaway Chess?
summary: chess.com Giveaway (antichess) vs online humans: the goal is to lose all your pieces; capturing is compulsory; no check or checkmate; the king is an ordinary piece; being stalemated also wins. Tony strings together forced captures and wins (game 4 noted as a win, others too).
rules: Captures are mandatory (choose among captures if several).
No check/checkmate; king can be captured and has no special status.
Win by losing all your pieces or by having no legal move (stalemate wins).
Pawns may promote to king (chess.com giveaway) — not mentioned in video.
win_condition: Lose all pieces or be stalemated.

board.theme_notes: chess.com; thumbnail: blue gift box with bow, 'Giveaway Chess?'

current_impl_issues: Impl base:Giveaway matches; ensure stalemate counts as a win for the stalemated side and opponent is human-like ~1500.
evidence: 0:01 'goal is to lose all of your pieces and capturing is compulsory. There are no checks or checkmates'; 2:58 'stalemate also wins you the game'; 15:00 'we do win game number four'.
